newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks soar to new highs amid buying fever.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks soar to new highs amid buying fever.

text.p: MADRID, May 21 (Reuter) 1515 GMT - Madrid stocks sailed up to uncharted territory, hitting new historic highs on Wednesday amid a frenzy of buying set off by good news on Spain's economy in recent months, dealers said.

"It's absolute madness, there's nothing for sale and to buy you have to raise prices without worrying about how much," one portfolio manager said. Trading also swelled to record volumes with a heavy presence of block trades.
The general index was up 12.54 points, 2.29 percent, to 560.10 and the Ibex-35 rose 149.16 points, 2.37 percent, to 6,449.01.

Dealers were divided in opinion about how long the spectacular upward trend could continue, with some already staying out of the market and others betting that selling would start with another one to three percent of index gains.
The size of the trading volume, which reached a record 180 billion pesetas, was another worrying factor for traders.
Buying pressure was so intense, dealers said they didn't know what to buy and were flocking to the bigger stocks like Telefonica, up 4.33 percent, and Repsol, up 2.13 percent.
Construction stocks were also popular with Dragados gaining 7.3 percent and FCC 6.19 percent.
